svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male-long-epaulet-plain","name":"Men's Class B blue long-sleeve shirt plain epaulet straps (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male-long; no grade)","size_in":{"w":25.8626,"h":32.9106},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2586.26,3291.06],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"The garment epaulet strap landmark polygons (epaulet_right / epaulet_left of garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male-long, width 1.0 in, Fig 4.8): the strap itself in the shirt colour with the shirt's line tones, topstitching and a button. The regulation gives no strap dimension.","anchors":{"top_center":[1293.1299999999999,0],"bottom_center":[1293.1299999999999,3291.0600000000004],"center":[1293.1299999999999,1645.5300000000002],"left_edge":[0,1645.5300000000002],"right_edge":[2586.2599999999998,1645.5300000000002],"epaulet_plain_right_center":[607.08,320.25],"epaulet_plain_left_center":[1979.18,320.25]},"landmarks":{"epaulet_plain_right":{"x":321.13,"y":182.9,"w":571.9,"h":274.7},"epaulet_plain_left":{"x":1693.23,"y":182.9,"w":571.9,"h":274.7}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)","overlay_of":"garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male-long","documented":["the shirt and blouse have epaulets for every member (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1 / 4.1.12.2)","shoulder cords are worn along the shoulder seam and, if the garment has an epaulet, underneath it (9.3, 9.4.1)","no grade goes on the strap itself: officers slip a gray or blue epaulet sleeve over it, NCOs and airmen wear chevrons or collar insignia"],"assumed":["strap size and shape (the traced base image does not draw it)","button size and position","topstitch inset"],"fit":{"method":"original","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
